description: This file defines an Angular service 'AuthService' responsible for handling authentication, token management, user loading, and related auth operations within the Thingsboard project.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Angular service managing authentication, token validation, user session, and related operations in the Thingsboard application.

methods.name: reloadUser
methods.description: Reloads user data and updates authentication state.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login with provided credentials.

methods.name: checkTwoFaVerificationCode
methods.description: Verifies 2FA code for multi-factor authentication.

methods.name: publicLogin
methods.description: Performs public login using a public ID.

methods.name: sendResetPasswordLink
methods.description: Sends a password reset link to the specified email.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates user account with token and password.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.description: Resets user password with provided reset token.

methods.name: changePassword
methods.description: Changes user password.

methods.name: getUserPasswordPolicy
methods.description: Retrieves password policy settings.

methods.name: activateByEmailCode
methods.description: Activates account via email code.

methods.name: resendEmailActivation
methods.description: Resends email activation link.

methods.name: loginAsUser
methods.description: Logs in as another user by user ID.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out current user, optionally capturing last URL.

methods.name: notifyUserLoaded
methods.description: Dispatches user load status to store.

methods.name: gotoDefaultPlace
methods.description: Navigates to default page based on auth state.

methods.name: loadOAuth2Clients
methods.description: Loads OAuth2 client configurations.

methods.name: getAvailableTwoFaLoginProviders
methods.description: Fetches available 2FA login providers.

methods.name: getAvailableTwoFaProviders
methods.description: Fetches available 2FA providers.

methods.name: forceDefaultPlace
methods.description: Determines if user should be redirected to default dashboard.

methods.name: defaultUrl
methods.description: Computes default navigation URL based on auth state.

methods.name: loadUser
methods.description: Loads user data based on tokens or query parameters.

methods.name: showLoginErrorDialog
methods.description: Displays login error dialog.

methods.name: procceedJwtTokenValidate
methods.description: Validates JWT token and loads user data.

methods.name: loadSystemParams
methods.description: Loads system parameters.

methods.name: refreshJwtToken
methods.description: Refreshes JWT token using refresh token.

methods.name: updatedAuthUserFromToken
methods.description: Updates auth user info from token data.

methods.name: validateJwtToken
methods.description: Checks validity of JWT token, optionally refreshes.

methods.name: refreshTokenPending
methods.description: Checks if token refresh is in progress.

methods.name: setUserFromJwtToken
methods.description: Sets user session from JWT token and optionally loads user data.

methods.name: updateAndValidateTokens
methods.description: Updates and validates access and refresh tokens.

methods.name: updateAndValidateToken
methods.description: Validates individual token and stores it.

methods.name: parsePublicId
methods.description: Extracts public ID from JWT token if available.

methods.name: notifyUnauthenticated
methods.description: Dispatches unauthenticated state.

methods.name: notifyAuthenticated
methods.description: Dispatches authenticated state with user info.

methods.name: updateAndValidateToken
methods.description: Validates token, stores it, and updates expiration.

methods.name: clearJwtToken
methods.description: Clears JWT token data.

methods.name: userForceFullscreen
methods.description: Determines if user should see fullscreen dashboard.

methods.name: userHasProfile
methods.description: Checks if user has a profile (not public).

methods.name: userHasDefaultDashboard
methods.description: Checks if user has a default dashboard.
